en: If you lived on the moon, you would be lighter than here on Earth, and if you had trained in low gravity, [[you]] [[would have adapted]] quickly during last year's space camp.
me: If you lived on the moon, you would be lighter than here on Earth, and if you had trained in low gravity,
quickly during last year's space camp.
easy: quickly during last year's space camp
if you had trained in low gravity
If you lived on the moon, you would be lighter than here on Earth
달에 산다면(live(살다)) 지구에서보다 더 가벼울 것이다.
요약: 저중력 훈련을 받았다면 작년 우주 캠프에서 빨리 적응했을 것이다.
notes: if + had p.p. → would have p.p. (과거 반대). would adapt ✕ → would have adapted ○. last year's가 과거 단서
adapt는 목적어 없이 쓰는 동사 → 1형식.

en: [[The child]] [[will become]] [[a great dancer]] if he receives professional training, although he has never taken a single class before.
key: 그 아이는 훌륭한 무용수가 될 것이다.
me: if he receives professional training, although he has never taken a single class before.
easy: The child will become a great dancer
그 아이는 훌륭한 무용수가 될 것이다(become(되다)).
although he has never taken a single class before
비록 전에 수업을 단 한 번도 받아 본 적이 없지만(take(받다)).
요약: 훈련만 받으면 수업 경험이 없어도 훌륭한 무용수가 된다.
notes: although + 주어+동사(절) / despite + 명사(구). despite he has ✕ → although he has ○
become + 명사 = ~이 되다 (주어 = 보어).

en: If the Wright brothers had invented airplanes sooner, air travel would have started much earlier, as [[people today]] [[complain]] as if travel delays were a brand-new problem.
me: If the Wright brothers had invented airplanes sooner, air travel would have started much earlier, as
as if travel delays were a brand-new problem.
easy: as if travel delays were a brand-new problem
마치 여행 지연이 완전히 새로운 문제인 것처럼.
If the Wright brothers had invented airplanes sooner, air travel would have started much earlier
라이트 형제가 비행기를 더 일찍 발명했더라면(invent(발명하다)) 항공 여행이 훨씬 더 일찍 시작되었을 것이다(start(시작하다)).
요약: 사람들은 지연을 마치 처음 겪는 문제인 듯 불평한다.
notes: as if + 과거형: 사실과 다른 상상. delays are ✕ → delays were ○ (주어가 복수여도 were)
complain은 목적어 없이 쓰는 동사 → 1형식, as if절은 덧붙는 말.

en: If you are afraid of standing on balconies, you can try starting on a lower floor, and [[most people who try this method]] [[feel]] [[confident]] about heights afterward.
me: If you are afraid of standing on balconies, you can try starting on a lower floor, and
most people who try this method
easy: If you are afraid of standing on balconies, you can try starting on a lower floor
발코니에 서는 게 무섭다면 더 낮은 층에서 시작해 볼 수 있다.
요약: 낮은 층부터 해 보면 높은 곳이 덜 무서워진다.
notes: feel / look / sound / seem + 형용사 = ~하게 느끼다/보이다. 부사 confidently ✕ → 형용사 confident ○
who try this method는 most people을 꾸미는 말. 꾸밈말을 가리면 주어(most people)가 보인다.

en: Many people would help if I asked them, but I prefer to solve problems myself, though if a true emergency happens, [[I]] [[will definitely ask for]] [[support]].
me: Many people would help if I asked them, but I prefer to solve problems myself, though if a true emergency happens,
easy: Many people would help if I asked them, but I prefer to solve problems myself
내가 부탁하면 많은 사람이 도와주겠지만, 나는 스스로 문제를 푸는 걸 더 좋아한다(prefer(선호하다)).
요약: 평소엔 스스로 해결하지만, 진짜 비상이면 꼭 도움을 청한다.
notes: if + 현재시제 → 주절 will: 실제로 일어날 수 있는 조건. would definitely ask ✕ → will definitely ask ○
한 문장에 if가 둘이면 절마다 따로 판단 (앞은 가정 would, 뒤는 실제 가능성 will).

en: The athlete plays every match as if it were a final match, and [[he]] [[would practice]] harder if his coach pushed him more.
me: The athlete plays every match as if it were a final match, and
harder if his coach pushed him more.
easy: if his coach pushed him more
The athlete plays every match as if it were a final match
그 선수는 마치 결승전인 것처럼 매 경기를 치른다(play(경기하다)).
요약: 코치가 더 몰아붙이면 그 선수는 더 열심히 연습할 것이다.
notes: if + 과거형(pushed) → 주절 would + 동사원형 (지금 사실의 반대). would have practiced ✕ → would practice ○
pushed(과거형)가 '지금 일의 상상'이라는 단서.

en: Angela spoke as if she had seen the car accident the day before, but she wasn't there, and [[such]] [[was]] [[her shock]] that she couldn't speak for several minutes.
me: Angela spoke as if she had seen the car accident the day before, but she wasn't there, and
that she couldn't speak for several minutes.
easy: that she couldn't speak for several minutes
그녀가 몇 분 동안 말을 할 수 없을 정도로.
Angela spoke as if she had seen the car accident the day before, but she wasn't there
Angela는 마치 전날 사고를 본 것처럼 말했지만(see(보다)) 그곳에 없었다.
요약: 충격이 너무 커서 몇 분 동안 말을 못 했다.
notes: such가 문장 맨 앞 → such + be동사 + 주어 (도치). such her shock was ✕ → such was her shock ○
원래 순서는 Her shock was such that ~ (그 충격이 너무 커서 ~).

en: He acted as if he had visited the city many times, but this was actually his first time, so [[his friends]] [[looked at]] [[him]] as if they knew his secret.
me: He acted as if he had visited the city many times, but this was actually his first time, so
as if they knew his secret.
easy: as if they knew his secret
He acted as if he had visited the city many times, but this was actually his first time
그는 마치 그 도시에 여러 번 와 본 것처럼 행동했지만(visit(방문하다)) 사실 처음이었다.
요약: 처음 온 그를 보고, 친구들은 비밀이라도 아는 듯 바라보았다.
notes: as if + 과거형: 사실과 다른 상상. know ✕ → knew ○
as if he had visited는 행동한 때보다 더 이전 일처럼 말할 때 쓰는 had p.p.

en: My dog sometimes barks at the air as if someone were there, and [[this strange behavior]] [[worries]] [[me]] every single day.
key: 이 이상한 행동은 나를 걱정하게 만든다.
me: My dog sometimes barks at the air as if someone were there, and
easy: 요약: 강아지가 허공에 짖는 모습이 매일 나를 걱정시킨다.
notes: and 뒤의 절에도 진짜 동사가 필요. worrying(-ing) ✕ → worries ○
worry는 '걱정시키다'라는 뜻으로 쓰이면 목적어(me)를 가진다.

en: Jackson knows very little, but he often behaves as if he had all the answers, though if someone corrects him politely, [[he]] [[will usually accept]] [[the feedback]] well.
me: Jackson knows very little, but he often behaves as if he had all the answers, though if someone corrects him politely,
easy: Jackson knows very little, but he often behaves as if he had all the answers
Jackson은 아는 게 거의 없지만 종종 마치 모든 답을 가진 것처럼 행동한다(behave(행동하다)).
요약: 아는 척은 해도, 정중히 지적받으면 대체로 잘 받아들인다.
notes: if + 현재시제(corrects) → 주절 will. would usually accept ✕ → will usually accept ○
as if he had는 사실과 다른 상상(과거형). 같은 문장이라도 as if절과 if절은 따로 판단한다.
